question: List the names of events that had more than 8 attendees and where at least one associated expense exceeded the average cost of all expenses.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_011"
FROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1."XCL_010" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN budget AS T3 ON T1."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN expense AS T4 ON T3."XCL_003" = T4."XCL_023"
WHERE T4."XCL_020" > (SELECT AVG("XCL_020") FROM expense)
GROUP BY T1."XCL_010", T1."XCL_011"
HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_001") > 8
